//: UI consistency guardrail. Flags raw hex/rgb(a) used for text `color:` so it must come from a token (var(--text*)/var(--menu-text*)). PHASE 0: severity is 'warning' (report mode) so it inventories drift without breaking the build. PHASE 2 flips this to an error and wires `npm run lint:css` into pre-push. tokens.css is the ONE place raw colors are allowed; OptionsFlow/intro are out of scope (partner-owned / documented decoration exception).

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Use a text token — var(--text) / --text-muted / --text-bright / --text-heading (or --menu-text*) — instead of a raw color for `color:`. See docs/superpowers/2026-08-24-color-inventory.md.
